description: Read-only RUNTIME STATUS of the QuoAPI MCP gateway, not a provider execution. With no arguments returns state, server protocol version, tool count, visible capability count and discovery/registry revisions. Optional capability handle adds public context only: this is not to test upstream execution, a live upstream health probe, credentials or tenant authorization. Use quoapi.describe for schemas, pricing and auth; quoapi.search to discover handles; quoapi.execute for approved actions. Unknown handles return capability_not_mcp_visible; status incurs no upstream charges.

capability.description: Optional exact canonical handle from quoapi.search (e.g. address.validate) to include publicly visible capability context. Omit to inspect the gateway overall; use quoapi.describe for schemas.

name: quoapi.inspect
title: Inspect QuoAPI runtime status
